richiami.difetto: Affected components may not have been correctly heat-treated during production resulting in reduced durability of the ball pins which may increase the risk of a subsequent drag link separation. A complete breakage in the drag link could sever the connection between the steering rod and both vehicle wheels leading to a lack of steerability and potentially to an increased accident risk with personal injury.
